[[File:Anagram reference - Kenner logo.png|thumb|right|260px|The Kenner logo.]]
'''Kenner''' (Kenner Products) is an American toy brand, founded in Cincinnati, Ohio, in 1946, that made the first Star Wars action figures. It held the Star Wars toy license from 1976 through 1985 and made the 3.75-inch action figure an industry standard. The company passed to General Mills in 1967, became part of Kenner Parker Toys in 1985, and was bought in 1987 by Tonka, itself bought by Hasbro in 1991. Hasbro closed Kenner's offices in 2000 and brought the brand back in 2010 with ''Star Wars: The Vintage Collection''.<ref name="wp-kenner">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenner_Products Kenner Products], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027184736/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenner_Products Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref>

== Star Wars CCG ==
[[File:JP-L-rennek.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Rennek]] ([[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]])|link=Rennek]]
The [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] card [[Rennek]] is an anagram of Kenner. The anagram list gives the relation as "Toy Co."<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> The card's lore reads:
<blockquote>Nerf herder. Personally oversees the herding of Jabba's nerfs. Scruffy-looking appearance conceals his expertise in unusual combat techniques.</blockquote>
